# -- tv_engineering_department.9308 (ceremony completion) -----------------------------------------
tv_engineering_department.9308 = {
	type = country_event
	outcome = neutral
	title = empty_text
	desc = empty_text
	hidden = yes

	trigger = {
		has_variable = tv_engineering_department_member
		has_variable = tv_wonder_locked
		has_variable = tv_wonder_ritual_in_progress
		has_variable = tv_wonder_ceremony_stage
		var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 8
	}

	immediate = {
		tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
	}
}
